footsteps/footsteps_on_leaves_natural_ou.fit_note: Di cham tren la kho ngoai troi, ghi am thuc te (field recording), crunching/rustling ro rang; dai 40.8s vuot muc 2-30s nen can cat ngan. Can dang nhap Freesound de tai file goc.
footsteps/footsteps_on_leaves_natural_ou.name: Footsteps on Leaves - Natural Outdoor Foley

footsteps/soft_leaves_wav.name: Soft Leaves.wav
